7 Trusted Storm Damage Roof Assessment Advice Tips

8 August 2025 Storm Damage

After a severe storm in Lehigh Valley, PA, your roof may have hidden damage you can’t see from the ground. Following reliable storm damage roof assessment advice can help you find problems early, prevent costly repairs, and protect your home’s value.

At In The Light Roofing, we’ve inspected and repaired countless roofs across the region after high winds, heavy rain, and hail. Our team knows the signs to look for and the steps to take for a safe, effective inspection. And when you need professional help, our Storm Damage Repair service is designed to restore your roof’s integrity fast.

Why Storm Damage Roof Assessment Advice Matters in Lehigh Valley, PA

In the Lehigh Valley, storms can bring everything from damaging hail to strong wind gusts. Even a “minor” storm can loosen shingles, crack flashing, or cause water infiltration. Following storm damage roof assessment advice specific to our area ensures you’re checking the right spots and not missing damage that could lead to expensive problems later.

Start with a Visual Ground Inspection

One of the safest storm damage roof assessment advice tips is to begin from the ground. Look for missing shingles, damaged gutters, and debris buildup. In Allentown, fallen branches and wind-blown objects are common after storms and may have impacted your roof.

Check for Attic Leaks and Water Stains

Water damage is often the first sign of roof issues. Another essential storm damage roof assessment advice step is to inspect your attic for damp insulation, mold, or water stains on rafters. Catching leaks early can prevent major structural repairs.

Look for Granule Loss on Asphalt Shingles

Granules protect your shingles from UV damage. If you find excessive granules in your gutters or downspouts, it’s a clear sign to follow up on storm damage roof assessment advice and have your shingles inspected.

Inspect Flashing and Roof Edges

Flashing around chimneys, skylights, and vents is a common failure point. One of the top storm damage roof assessment advice tips from our experts is to ensure flashing is still tightly sealed and free from cracks or lifting.

Evaluate Gutter and Downspout Condition

If your gutters are bent, detached, or clogged with debris after a storm, water won’t drain properly. This can lead to roof leaks and siding damage. It’s a simple but important part of storm damage roof assessment advice to make sure water is flowing freely away from your home.

Document All Visible Damage

When following storm damage roof assessment advice, take clear, time-stamped photos of all damage. This is crucial for insurance claims and helps professionals understand the scope of the problem before they arrive.

Schedule a Professional Roof Inspection

While homeowners can spot obvious damage, a trained eye can detect hidden issues. Our team specializes in storm damage roof assessment advice for Lehigh Valley homes, using both experience and advanced tools to ensure nothing gets overlooked.

Visit Us in Allentown, PA

We’re proud to serve the entire Lehigh Valley region with trusted roofing services. Visit us in Allentown, PA to discuss your storm repair needs or book a professional inspection.

Frequently Asked Questions

What should I do immediately after a storm hits my home?

Start by following basic storm damage roof assessment advice, check for visible damage from the ground and ensure your home is safe before entering.

Can small roof damage wait for repairs?

No. Delaying repairs can turn minor issues into costly structural damage.

Does insurance cover storm damage repairs?

In many cases, yes. Proper documentation from a professional helps ensure your claim is processed smoothly.

How often should I have my roof inspected after storms?

Anytime your home experiences high winds, hail, or heavy rain, you should follow storm damage roof assessment advice and arrange an inspection.

Can I inspect my roof myself?

You can perform a basic check from the ground, but for safety and thoroughness, follow professional storm damage roof assessment advice and hire an expert.

What signs mean I need immediate roof repair?

Missing shingles, visible holes, water stains inside, and sagging areas require urgent attention.
